detail.longDescription: Texting can be a great way to stay connected to your work on the go. You can talk to your team, your boss—maybe even your mom if you need a little encouragement. And with tools like WhatsApp, you can text across time zones and countries for free, which is a great perk if you have a distributed team. But texting isn't just for keeping in touch.
